title: A queued prompt enqueued with a durability prerequisite is promoted by no dispatch entry point until its exact persistence acknowledgement
outcome: A queued prompt enqueued with a durability prerequisite is promoted by no dispatch entry point until its exact persistence acknowledgement
acceptance: A queued prompt enqueued with a durability prerequisite, bound to its prompt id and exact queued content, is promoted or sent by no dispatch entry point — turn-end auto-dispatch, direct send, mailbox wake, Resume and bypass variants, wait resumes, orchestrator transitions, Engram retries and boot orphan dispatch — until a content-specific persistence acknowledgement of that exact entry is received. A held head blocks automatic FIFO behind it. A failed acknowledgement leaves it held with its reason. A late acknowledgement after Stop, Cancel or removal, or for a replaced entry, releases nothing. An entry read back from the durable row after a restart is eligible because its content is durable; no default flag grants eligibility. Entries without the prerequisite behave exactly as today. Barrier tests hold the writer after the in-memory enqueue, drive each entry point and show zero promotions, then one after the exact acknowledgement.
No new poller, watchdog, timer, sleep or enlarged timeout is introduced; release happens on the existing acknowledgement and dispatch paths.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
